Xander de Vries  
Email: xander.devries@example.com | Phone: +91 9876543210 | New Delhi, India  

Professional Experience  
At VitaTech Solutions, I contributed to the development of a telehealth platform, focusing on backend infrastructure and frontend integration. My work involved designing REST APIs with Node.js to enable seamless communication between frontend components built with Vue.js. I also collaborated on database schema improvements for PostgreSQL, optimizing query performance to support real-time data updates. During my internship at HealthInsight Analytics, I supported the creation of patient data visualization tools, leveraging Python for data processing and React for interactive dashboards. This role allowed me to explore the intersection of data analysis and user-centric design, refining my ability to translate complex datasets into accessible insights.  

Technical Skills  
I routinely work with Node.js to build scalable backend systems, particularly in environments requiring real-time data synchronization. PostgreSQL is my go-to relational database, where I’ve focused on query optimization and schema design to meet application performance needs. Python remains a key tool for data manipulation and prototyping, especially in scenarios requiring rapid iteration. For frontend development, I’ve used React to create dynamic user interfaces, often integrating TypeScript to maintain type safety and improve code maintainability. REST API design is central to my workflow, ensuring consistent and secure endpoints for both internal and external services. GraphQL has been instrumental in reducing redundant data fetching, particularly in projects requiring flexible data queries.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Amsterdam, 2022. Graduated with a focus on software engineering principles and distributed systems, complemented by coursework in database management and full-stack development.  

Projects  
At HealthInsight Analytics, I contributed to a project that transformed raw patient data into visual analytics tools. Using Python, I automated data cleaning and aggregation, while React enabled interactive dashboards that allowed clinicians to monitor trends effectively. At VitaTech, I worked on expanding the telehealth platform’s features, including implementing GraphQL endpoints to streamline data retrieval for frontend components. This involved refining existing REST APIs to reduce latency and improve user experience.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Dutch (proficient), Hindi (basic).  

Certifications
